name: Puerto Rico
dek: A US territory. San Juan Luis Muñoz Marín Airport, WMO 78526.
paragraphs: Puerto Rico is a US territory; this is its own sheet. The reference station is San Juan Luis Muñoz Marín International Airport, WMO 78526, height 3 m, position 18°25′57″N, 66°00′39″W.

The highest average high in the table is 31.8 °C, in September. The lowest average low is 22.1 °C, in February. The wettest month by the precipitation column is November, at 187.1 mm, and the driest is March, at 55.4 mm. No official tipping source was found on this pass, so that line is missing.

plugs.label: Plugs and voltage
plugs.value: Type A and B, 120 V, 60 Hz
plugs.detail: The IEC world-plugs list, in the copy archived on 16 August 2026, shows Puerto Rico at the voltage, frequency, and plug types in the figure. A direct download of the live page did not return the list, so the archive is the copy that was read.

driving.label: Driving side
driving.value: Same side as the US mainland
driving.detail: Discover Puerto Rico, the island's official destination marketing site, says: "Driving here is on the same side of the road as the mainland as well." The page does not use the word "right"; on the US mainland traffic keeps right.

water.label: Tap water
water.detail: CDC's traveler page for Puerto Rico, last reviewed August 25, 2026, does not say whether tap water is safe or unsafe. It says food and water standards around the world vary based on the destination, that standards may also differ within a country, and that risk may change depending on the activity. It points readers to CDC's food and water precautions. This page does not turn that into medical advice.

currency.label: Currency
currency.detail: ISO 4217 lists the US Dollar, code USD, under its own entry for Puerto Rico.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.detail: IANA's zone.tab gives Puerto Rico one row, America/Puerto_Rico. zone1970.tab lists the same zone on a row shared with Canada (Lower North Shore of Quebec) and many Caribbean territories.

entry.label: Official entry requirements
entry.note: CBP's page for international visitors. Puerto Rico is a US territory. We do not restate a visa rule.
